description: Built-in, portable leak rules for the PNM Delivery Architect package. Contains no organisation names; organisation-specific terms are supplied at run time through an optional external denylist.

rules.label: custom API name
rules.why: Custom suffixes identify one organisation's metadata. Use a placeholder such as <Prefix>_<Field>__c.

rules.label: custom prefix
rules.why: Upper-case prefixes followed by a component name usually belong to one organisation's naming convention.

rules.label: absolute or workspace path
rules.why: Paths belong in a workspace adapter, not in the portable package.

rules.label: named tool or server identifier
rules.why: The package refers to capabilities; tool bindings belong in a workspace adapter.

allowNote: XYZ_ and ABC_ are reserved as deliberately arbitrary prefixes for evaluation fixtures and illustrative examples.
